[color=#ff1c18]ESTABLISH INVESTIGATION RELATIONSHIPS[/color]

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] Organize your [color=#ff1c18]DISCOVERIES[/color] on the [color=#ff1c18]INVESTIGATION BOARD[/color]. [color=#ff8864]Connect[/color] [color=#ff1c18]CARDS[/color] with [color=#ff1c18]COLORED THREADS[/color] based on uncovered [color=#ff1c18]RELATIONSHIPS[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] TYPES OF LINKS
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]SOLID LINE[/color] ([color=#ff8864]CONFIRMED[/color]): [color=#ff1c18]Established[/color] and [color=#ff1c18]verified relationship[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]DASHED LINE[/color] ([color=#ff8864]PROBABLE[/color]): [color=#ff1c18]Relationship to be confirmed[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]LINK COLOR[/color]: [color=#ff8864]Each color[/color] represents a [color=#ff8864]type of relationship[/color] ([color=#ff1c18]culprit[/color], [color=#ff1c18]witness[/color], [color=#ff1c18]friend[/color], [color=#ff1c18]enemy[/color], [color=#ff1c18]ownership[/color], etc.).

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] USING THE INVESTIGATION BOARD
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]PIN CARDS[/color]: Pin the cards [color=#ff8864]representing[/color] the [color=#ff1c18]COLLECTED INFORMATION[/color] on the [color=#ff8864]investigation board[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]CONNECT CARDS[/color]: Use [color=#ff1c18]COLORED THREADS[/color] to [color=#ff8864]connect cards[/color] based on the discovered [color=#ff1c18]RELATIONSHIPS[/color]. Each [color=#ff8864]thread[/color] [color=#ff1c18]SYMBOLIZES[/color] a [color=#ff1c18]LINK[/color] [color=#ff8864]between[/color] [color=#ff1c18]CLUES[/color], [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTERS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]LOCATIONS[/color] and other [color=#ff1c18]threads[/color], helping to [color=#ff8864]define a PATTERN[/color], [color=#ff8864]identify a[/color] [color=#ff1c18]CULPRIT[/color], and [color=#ff8864]rebuild[/color] [color=#ff1c18]EVENTS[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] MODIFYING THE BOARD
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] A [color=#ff1c18]LEFT-CLICK[/color] on a [color=#ff8864]card[/color] [color=#ff1c18]SHRINKS[/color] or [color=#ff1c18]ENLARGES[/color] it.
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] You can [color=#ff1c18]MOVE CARDS[/color] by [color=#ff8864]grabbing[/color] them from the [color=#ff8864]colored top[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To [color=#ff1c18]MOVE[/color] a [color=#ff1c18]LINK END[/color], [color=#ff8864]move[/color] the [color=#ff1c18]PINS[/color] at the [color=#ff8864]ends[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To [color=#ff1c18]ESTABLISH[/color] a [color=#ff8864]LINK[/color], [color=#ff1c18]CHANGE[/color] its [color=#ff8864]nature[/color], or just [color=#ff1c18]DELETE[/color] it: [color=#ff1c18]RIGHT-CLICK[/color]...
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To [color=#ff1c18]TEMPORARILY REMOVE[/color] a [color=#ff8864]card[/color], [color=#ff1c18]DRAG & DROP[/color] the [color=#ff8864]card[/color] into the [color=#ff1c18]POSSIBLE CLUES[/color] area (and [color=#ff8864]vice versa[/color]).
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] To [color=#ff1c18]DEFINITIVELY THROW[/color] a [color=#ff8864]card[/color] [color=#ff1c18]AWAY[/color], [color=#ff1c18]RIGHT-CLICK[/color] on the [color=#ff8864]card[/color]...

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] VALIDATE OR GIVE UP CASE
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] In order to [color=#ff1c18]VALIDATE[/color] a [color=#ff1c18]CASE[/color], you'll need [color=#ff8864]at least[/color] [color=#ff1c18]1 CULPRIT[/color], [color=#ff1c18]1 EVIDENCE[/color], and [color=#ff1c18]1 MOTIVE[/color] (and quickly, more
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] You can [color=#ff1c18]VALIDATE[/color] or [color=#ff1c18]GIVE UP[/color] a [color=#ff8864]case[/color] by using the [color=#ff8864]TOP BAR menu[/color], select "[color=#ff8864]CASES[/color]", then "[color=#ff8864]VALIDATE CASE![/color]" or "[color=#ff8864]GIVE UP CASE...[/color]"[color=#ff1c18][shake rate=7.0 level=5 connected=0]...[/shake][/color]
